name: lachesis muta venom + pulsatilla vulgaris + sepia officinalis juice + sulfur
purpose: USES Temporarily relieves hot flashes and other symptoms associated with change of life.
uses: INDICATIONS LACHESIS Sore throat PULSATILLA Weeping SEPIA Indifference SULPHUR Agitation
otcwarn: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist or recur, discontinue use. If pregnant or nursing, consult a licensed practitioner before using this product.
